plan.notes: Catalog footnote (VNSG 1226): VNSG 1226 Gerontology , VNSG 1301 Mental Health and Mental Illness , and VNSG 1162 Clinical III - Practical Nurse will rotate second and third term. To be eligible for this degree, the student must have completed the Vocational Nursing certificate program. Students must earn a C or better in all Vocational Nursing (VNSG) and all science courses and maintain an overall cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 to remain in and/or graduate from the program.
